releaseNotes:
- Gives every AgentOS data home a stable deployment identity and includes it in Cube workspace ownership, so two AgentOS installations using the same Cube account, template, workspace, and Agent IDs no longer reuse one another's sandbox
- Applies the same deployment-scoped lookup to the Core-owned model Relay and to old-template retirement, preventing one installation from connecting to or deleting another installation's Cube workspace
- Leaves legacy Cube sandboxes without a deployment identity untouched during migration so upgrading one installation cannot interrupt another instance that is still running an older Core
- Reuses AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.7`; no Runtime package or template payload changed in this Core-only release

### Verification

- Passed focused deployment-identity and Cube provider regression coverage, including two deployments creating the same logical workspace concurrently
- Verified against the configured Cube service that two deployment identities created distinct sandboxes in 270 ms and 273 ms, then removed both test sandboxes and confirmed no test resource remained
- Passed the complete production build and all 332 TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK tests, plus the Sandbox VMM Go suite and all 10 Java 8 SDK tests
